title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for C_p must be correctly stated as C_p = 5/2 R.

title: Entropy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of entropy S must be derived correctly from the Gibbs free energy G.

title: Partial Derivative
description: Important Criteria: The partial derivative of S with respect to T must be correctly evaluated to find C_p.

title: Correct Constants
description: Important Criteria: The constants a and R must be correctly identified and used in the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common sign errors in the calculation of the entropy or specific heat.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Ensure that units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Logical Flow
description: Optional Criteria: The response should follow a logical flow from Gibbs free energy to specific heat.
